chat and its branches answer one at a time. Only a completed answer the chat
saved with its runtime entry ID qualifies, and only while nothing runs in
the chat or its branches. The same request again returns the same session.

CalibrationAdmission.title: CalibrationAdmission
CalibrationAdmission.description:
Whether an agent session created in a calibration session may operate.

An agent session created with a calibration session ID is written ``pending`` and can do
nothing (no action, measurement, commit, apply, or pause) until its reservation in the
calibration session is finalized. Finalizing removes the reservation and records its ID in
``CalibrationSessionDocument.admitted_reservation_ids`` in one update, so the outcome is
durable proof in the parent:

``admitted``: the reservation was finalized; the session operates under its own policy.
``rejected``: the reservation was cleared without being finalized (the calibration session
was closed first). The session is cancelled and never operates.

A session created alone, or before admission existed, has no admission and keeps the
behavior it always had.

record of hardware writes, so this never states the current or last written hardware state.

``execution_outcome``, from QDash's dispatch and execution records only: ``refused``: QDash
refused the launch and created no flow run. ``unknown``: the launch is still being reported
or its outcome is unknown. ``no_execution``: the flow run was created and QDash holds no
execution record for it. ``running``: an execution is still open. ``failed``: every
execution ended and none completed. ``partial``: some executions completed and others
failed or were cancelled. ``completed``: every execution completed. Runs outside the
session are not considered.

qids.title: Qids
qids.description: Qubit ids as QDash lists them, e.g. ["0", "1"]. Set exactly one of qids and mux_ids, as a nonempty list without duplicates.

mux_ids.title: Mux Ids
mux_ids.description: MUX ids; every qubit of each MUX is a target. Set exactly one of qids and mux_ids, as a nonempty list without duplicates.

exclude_qids.title: Exclude Qids
exclude_qids.description: Qubits to leave out of the MUX targets. Must be empty with qids.

PipelineTargets.title: PipelineTargets
PipelineTargets.description:
Which qubits the pipeline starts from: explicit qids or whole MUXes.

Set exactly one of qids and mux_ids to a nonempty list without duplicates.
exclude_qids may be nonempty only with mux_ids.

run.title: Run
run.description: Run parameters. A plain value, {"value": ..., "value_type": ...}, or a sweep declaration {"value": [start, stop, step_or_num], "value_type": "np.arange" | "np.linspace" | "np.logspace" | "range"} or {"value": [points...], "value_type": "list"}.

input.title: Input
input.description: Calibration input overrides, as plain values.

update_calibration_parameters.title: Update Calibration Parameters
update_calibration_parameters.description: False records outputs as measurement history only. None inherits the next layer and finally the workflow's policy.

TaskSettings.title: TaskSettings
TaskSettings.description:
Common per-task defaults: run parameters, input overrides, persistence policy.

A workflow's ``task_parameters`` maps a task name to one of these; every call
of that task starts from it. :class:`TaskCall` carries the same fields for one
call.

step_id.title: Step Id
step_id.description: Identifier of this step, unique within the pipeline; filters reference it. Defaults to the step's name. Set it when a pipeline runs the same step type twice.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Task calls to run on every target, in order. A task may appear more than once when each occurrence has its own call_id. Defaults to FULL_2Q_TASKS.

execution_mode.title: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: automatic (default): run an earlier GenerateCRSchedule schedule or generate one from the candidate qubits. manual: run the pairs listed in `rounds` exactly as written.

rounds.title: Rounds
rounds.description: Required with execution_mode manual and rejected otherwise: the rounds in run order, each a list of directed [control, target] pairs, e.g. [[["0", "1"], ["4", "5"]], [["8", "9"]]]. Each pair must be a chip coupling in that direction, the pairs of a round may not share a qubit, a MUX or a modeled readout/control module, and both qubits of every pair must be current candidates. Rounds are never regrouped, reversed or split.

max_parallel_ops.title: Max Parallel Ops
max_parallel_ops.description: Pairs per automatically generated CR group; omitted or null uses 10. Rejected with execution_mode manual unless omitted or null.
